name: Istanbul
about: Spring and fall have the most comfortable weather, summer is hot and packed, winter is cool and quiet.
overview: A city split across two continents, where Byzantine and Ottoman landmarks sit a tram ride from some of the best street food anywhere.
costOverview: Tea and a kebab plate cost little; the big-ticket landmarks are a different price bracket entirely.
